(ta)༄༅/ /'phags pa dzambha la dmar po gsung gi sgrub pa'i skor cha tshang ba bzhugs so::grwa pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar gyi gter byon/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// 'phags pa dzambha la dmar po gsung gi sgrub pa'i skor cha tshang ba bzhugs so: :grwa pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar gyi gter byon// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du: ārya dzambha la sā dha naṃ nā maḥ bod skad du: 'phags pa dzambha la'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba: 'phags pa dzambha la la phyag 'tshal lo: yid bzhin rin chen gter 'di bsgrub pa dang : ma lus 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba'i phyir: nor lha kun gyi nang nas dzambha la: dmar po gsung gi sgrub pa yang dag bshad: de la dang po sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba bsal ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas dkon mchog dang 'phags pa dzambha la la skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o: de nas sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir: bdag gis dzambha la bsgrub snyam du sems bskyed la: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddha3haṃ: zhes pas brtan g.yo thams cad stong par bsgom: de'i ngang las a las zla ba: ma las nyi ma: pam̐ las padma'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge dzam̐ dmar po las 'od 'phros: sems can gyi don byas: tshur 'dus te dzam̐ la phog yongs su gyur pa las: dzambha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: sku shin tu dmar ba: chags pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa: klu chen po brgyad dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa: zhal g.yas dkar ba: g.yon sngo ba: rtsa zhal dmar ba: phyag g.yas dang pos rin po che: bar pas lcags kyu: g.yon dang po na thod pa rin po ches gang ba: gnyis pa na zhags pa: tha ma gnyis na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams nas btsir bas nor bu skyugs pa: zhabs bzhis gnod sbyin nor bu skyugs pa gnyis mnan pa de lta bu bsgom mo: de'i thugs kar yi ge hrīḥdamar mo las lha mo ku ru kulle sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma: dang po gnyis mda' gzhu: g.yas 'og ma lcags kyu: g.yon 'og ma zhags pa bsnams par bskyed la: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas:

lha mo ku ru kulle sku mdog dmar mo g.yas lcags kyu: g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa grangs med pa spros te: 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas kyi rnam pa gang 'dod pa la lcags kyus bzung : zhags pas bcings nas rang gi khyim du drangs: rang gi khang par mi shong pa tsam du spungs te ster bar bsam: dzambha la'i zhal dang : ne'u le'i zhal dang gnod sbyin nor skyugs gnyis po'i zhal nas: gser g.yu mu tig bye ru la sogs pa zad mi shes pa brul nas: rang gi khang pa khengs par bsgom zhing : oṃ dzambha lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā: zhes pa'i bsnyen pa byas pas mnyes nas nor gyi dngos grub byin par bsam: bsnyen pa ci rigs pa bya: rab stong tsho: 'bring lnga brgya: tha ma sum brgya chag tu mi rung : tho rangs kyi cha'am mtshan mo'i cha la bzla zhing : gong gi dmigs pa yang yang du bsgom: nam langs pa dang chu sbyin dang gtor ma gtong : rgyun du bzlas pas 'grub ste: sngon du bsnyen pa zhag bdun byas nas de nas rgyun du sgrub pa byas na shin tu legs: chu sbyin pa'i thabs la: mdun du zangs gzhong du sngar bzhin bskyed nas de'i thugs kar ram̐ dmar po bsam: de nas ram̐ zhes brjod pas me 'bar te zhal gyi nang nas yar me lce byung bas shin tu skom pas gdungs par bsam: de'i zhal du chu rtsa sngags kyis phul bas skom pa'i sdug bsngal zhi nas mnyes te: zhal dang ne'u le dang nor skyugs rnams kyi zhal nas rin po che sna tshogs pa byung bar bsam: de yang dzambha la skom pas gdung ba la chu byin pas skom pa sangs nas mnyes te nor bu skyugs: dzambha la dgyes te ne'u le btsir bas nor bu skyugs: nor skyugs gnyis kyi snying gar rdog pas cher mnan pas nor bu skyugs: de nas dzambha la'i zhal dang : ne'u le dang nor bu skyugs pa dang gsum la lag pas reg par bsams te: oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byang chub kyi sems kyi chu dmar po lce la reg par bzhag la dngos grub blang :

chu de rang gis longs spyad: yang na chu bo chen por dor ro: de nas gtor ma sbyin pa ni: zangs gzhong du zan dang chang dang sha dang mar dang bu ram dang zas kyi rnam pa 'byor tshad dang : nas la sogs pa 'bru dang : ma 'byor na rang gang za ba'i kha zas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs la bzang zhing rgya che ba gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya phun sum tshogs par bsams la: rtsa sngags la ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi btags pas phul la: ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes nas nor gyi dngos grub byung bar bsam: gnas gsum nas rin po che 'dzag par bsam: lan bdun du mchod pa dbul: bstod pa bya: badzra muḥs rang gi snying gar gzhag: gtor ma rang gis longs spyad do: gtor ma la brten te sgrub pa'o: ga'u la brten te sgrub pa ni: ga'u zangs sam rdza las byas pa li khri'am mtshal gyis dmar por byugs la 'khor lo dpe'u chung bzhin bris la: de'i nang du btsal ba'i rdzas la: phyug po chen po dgu'i nas sna: g.yang gi nas sna: phyug po chen po dgu'i zas sna dang 'bru: nor sna dang : gnag rta lug ba ra la sogs pa'i spu dang :

mdzo dre'u phag pa ma gtogs pa/ gser g.yu zangs dang dngul lcags la sogs pa rin po che: zhing mu ma'i sa: dus rgyun lo tog legs po skye ba'i zhing*/ khang pa bkra shis pa'i sa: sngar bla ma bzang po byon cing dme 'khrugs sogs ma byung ba/ gnas gzhi'i rgya thab kyi sa: dge bshes bsod nams can gyi sa: mi bsod nams can gyis gos kyi dum bu: ga bur la sogs pa'i sman sna: tshong 'dus tshogs pa'i sa: rkun chen gyi lag pa: zas sna'i rigs 'byor tshad: na chung 'phyon ma'i ka cha: skyes bu gzhon nu'i nor sna: dge bshes kyi sems rten: yon bdag phyug mo'i sems rten: lnga po des de rnams dbang du 'du'o: lo legs pa'i snye ma: tshong legs pa'i nor gyi dum bu: 'brog legs pa'i mar: 'bul ba mang po byung ba'i nor sna: rgyal pos bsdus pa'i nor sna: de rnams sna tshang ma rnyed na gang 'byor bsags la 'khor lo'i nang du bcug la khengs par dgang : khyad par du rang gang dga' ba 'dod pa'i ming rnams yi ger bris la dngos grub stsol zhes bris pa gzhug: dus dus su mchod bstod bya: 'grub sbyor bzang dus/ rang la 'bul ba byung ba'i phud dang zas phud rnams ga'ur bskyal lo: lhag ma dang zas sna rnams dngos grub tu bsams la longs spyad: gos sna rnams lhan par btab la bgo'o: dzambha la dmar po'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs so: dzambha la thod pa la brten te sgrub pa ni: thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du dzam dmar gyi lder bzo'am: de min na shog bu la bris pa gzhug: rang gi 'dod pa'i ming yang gzhug: gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs: sha mar bu ram la sogs pa zas sna tshogs: nas dang 'bras dang gro dang sran ma la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs: dar zab sna tshogs: ras snam la sogs gos sna tshogs te: de rnams kyi thod pa khengs par bkang la: thod pa'i nang du mthing shog la mtshal la rin po che brdar bas dzam dmar gyi snying po bris pa'i mthar:

bdag la nor stsol bya ba bris la gzhug: bang mdzod du sba'o: skabs su mchod bstod bya'o: 'grub sbyor dang g.yang skar la/ thod pa la brten te sgrub pa rdzogs so: dzambha la'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa las dbang du bya ba'i phrin las ni: rang skad cig gis stong par bsgom: a las zla ba: ma las nyi ma: pam̐ las padma: de'i steng du dzam̐ las 'od 'phros pas: 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu zhig gis 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi snying bsgul: sems g.yos nas bdag la thams cad chags par bsgom: de tshur 'dus pas dzam̐ la phog ste dzam̐ yongs su gyur pa las: dzambha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhal g.yas dkar g.yon mthing : dbus dmar ba: phyag g.yas dang po na rin po che: gnyis pa na lcags kyu: g.yon dang po na thod pa rin po ches bkang ba: gnyis pa na zhags pa: gsum pa gnyis na ne'u le btsir ba: zhabs bzhi pa gnod sbyin nor skyugs kyi steng na bzhugs pa: de lta bu sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa zhig bsam: de'i thugs kar sbas pa'i yum ku ru kulle dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma: g.yas dang g.yon gyi dang po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa: g.yas gnyis pa na lcags kyu: g.yon gnyis pa na zhags pa bsnams pa: de las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas lcags kyu: g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa dpag tu med pa spros te 'jig rten khams kyi sems can thams cad lcags kyus bzung : zhags pas mgul nas bcings nas bdag gi mdun du rang dbang med par bkug par bsam: de thams cad kyis bdag la mos pa dang gus pas thal mo sbyar nas gus pa tshad med par byed par bsam: dzambha la'i thugs ka'i ku ru kulle'i thugs ka nas lha mo dmar mo gcig spros te bsgrub bya rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas dbang bskur te spyi bo nas snying gar babs pas sems bsgul te bdag la yid chags myos te bdag gi mdun na brgyal nas 'dug par bsam:

yang ku ru kulle'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros te bsgrub bya la phog pas dmar lam song ste chags pas cher myos te rang dbang med par bdag la yid chags par bsam: de lta bu yang yang bsam zhing sngags 'di bzla'o: oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya ku ru kulle hrīḥsarba lo ka wā shaṃ ku ru hrīḥswā hā: zhes bzlas pas rtags ni rmi lam du bdag la bud med kyi tshogs kyis bsnyen bkur byed pa dang : phyag 'tshal ba dang 'bul ba byed pa 'byung : mi chen po rnams kyis kyang bdag la bsnyen bkur byed pa 'byung : dngos su yang skye bo thams cad yid chags nas mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa skye: blo chos la 'dzud nus: dbang du 'du nges so: 'di la dam tshig tu chos la phyogs ris mi bya: gang zag la skur pa mi gdab: chos dang gang zag la bstod sgra 'ba' zhig gtang : smad sgra mi gtang : gam du 'ongs pa thams cad la chos dang zang zing gis phan gdags: kun dang blo bstun: kun gyi blo dang mthun par chos bshad: gti mug can la gti mug gi chos bshad: grub mtha' sogs la'ang grub mtha' brgal brtag dang yin min mi bya: 'thad pa brjod pas dbang du 'du nges: gsang nas spyad na dngos grub thob nges so: : dzam dmar sbyin sreg la brten te sgrub pa ni: rgyas pa'i shing 'o ma can la sogs pa las: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i dbyibs can du bris nas der me thab gru bzhir brtsigs te: bsreg rdzas nas dang : 'bras dang : gro dang : rin po che dang : sha mar bu ram la sogs pa zas sna dang : gos chen po la sogs gos sna dang : zhun mar rnams bsags la me lha dzaṃ la dmar por bskyed: de'i zhal du bsreg rdzas rnams sngags 'dis dbul lo: oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥdzwa la ram̐ ratna siddhi hūm̐: zhes phul bas mnyes te zhal nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'dzag: phyag gi ne'u le dang gnod sbyin nor skyugs kyi kha nas rin po che 'dzag par bsam:

des ni dngos grub ma lus pa 'thob bo: sbyin sreg la brten nas dbang du bya bar 'dod na: tsan dmar mdzo mo shing shug pa sogs kyis me thab zla gam du brtsigs la der me lha dzam dmar bskyed: bsreg rdzas me tog glang sna dang ug chos: mar rgya skyegs sam 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur te: rgya skyegs kyis liṅga bris la: dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥche ge mo wā shaṃ ku ru hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pas liṅga byin la: de nas bsreg rdzas rnams sbyin: ting nge 'dzin ni bdag dang me lha dzam dmar khyad med du bskyed: de'i thugs ka nas lha mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros: lcags kyus snying nas bzung : zhags pas mgul nas bcings nas me lha'i mdun du 'ongs nas gus pas thal mo sbyar nas 'dug pa la bsreg rdzas rnams phul bas: dzambha la'i thugs ka nas lha mo dmar mo gcig 'phros te dbang bskur nas bdag la yid chags par bsam: de nas bsreg rdzas rnams me lha'i zhal du phul bas 'od zer thugs ka nas dmar lam gyis byung ba bsgrub bya la phog pas chags pas yid myos te bsreg rdzas phul bas me cher 'bar te: bsgrub bya chags pa'i mes yid gdungs nas bdag la shin tu yang chags par bsam: 'jig rten gyi mi thams cad la byas na bsod nams kyis rgyal khams kun 'ur 'ong ngo : gcig la byas na gang la byas pa de bran bzhin du 'gyur ro: 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la sbyin sreg 'bum phrag gcig: dge bshes bsod nams can dang rgyal po chen po la khri phrag gcig: ya rabs la stong phrag gcig: ma rabs dang bud med la sbyin sreg brgya phrag gcig gis 'grub bo: sbyin sreg gis dbang du bya ba'o: dzambha la la tshogs dbul ba ni: nang nub zas tshogs su byed kyang rung : nam 'byor pas nam byed kyang rung : zhal zas sna tshogs pa rnams bshams la: sngon 'gro yi dam la gzhung bsrangs kyang legs:

de min na dzam dmar gyi mngon rtogs bsgom: swa bhā was yo byad sbyangs la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab: oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ zhes pas dgyes nas gsol bar bsam: gsol bas mnyes nas nor bu 'dzag pa gsum la dmigs pa gtad do: mgrin par dzam dmar bskyed: bdag kyang dzam dmar du bskyed de gsol bas mnyes nas zas kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo: sa ma ya: : bstod pa ni: bde gshegs kun gyi gsung las rab sprul zhing : thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs: dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzambha la: ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong la phyag 'tshal: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhis nor skyugs mnan: 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin rin chen dang : khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu g.yas: g.yon gnyis nor bus gang ba'i thod pa dang : 'ching byed zhags pas khams gsum 'ching bar byed: tha gnyis ne'u le btsir zhing rin chen 'bebs: ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal lo: zhal g.yas dkar bas lha rigs dbang du sdud: zhal g.yon sngo bas klu rigs dbang du sdud: dbus zhal dmar bas mi rnams dbang du sdud: srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo: sku la rin chen du mas rnam par brgyan: klu chen brgyad dang lha yi na bzas brgyan: sgeg pa'i nyams ldan 'gro ba kun yid sdud: mgon po dzambha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag la longs spyod nor chen dngos grub stsol: zhes pas bstod do: 'khor lo bri ba ni: lte ba la oṃ: de'i phyi rim mu khyud yi ge shong tsam la: dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā: de'i phyi rim yi ge shong tsam la rin chen sna bdun gyi snying po bri: de'i phyi rim sor gnyis kyi tshad tsam la padma 'dab brgyad la bkra shis rdzas brgyad bri: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la dzambha la'i gzungs kyi mjug tu sarb+ba lo ka wā shaṃ ku ru zhes bri:

de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug la gnod sbyin pho brgyad mo brgyad kyi snying po bri: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la rnam sras dang nor rgyun ma'i gzungs bri: de'i phyi rim la: bdag la gser dngul zangs lcags rta glang lug zhing khang 'bru bang mdzod 'jig rten gyi yid bzhin nor gyi dngos grub 'dod rgu stsol cig: ces bri: de'i phyi rim la dzambha la dmar po'i zhal bri'o: zhal gsum phyag drug rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i lto bar 'khor lo tshud pa'o// oṃ hrīḥdzambha la dza lend+rā ya 'gro ba mi'i tsitta a pa ra dzī ta dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ hrīḥdzaḥhūm̐ dzambha la ratna a mu ka ā karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ nor rdzas thams cad bdag la dung dung sdus sdus mgo nag mi'i sems dkrugs snying 'phyo ru chug rkang pa 'gro ru chug yid kyi rnam par shes pa rang dbang med par khug la shog sarb+ba lo ka wā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐: tshig bar gya bdun yod : zab rgya rgya rgya: ༈ dzambha la'i khyad par gyi sgrub thabs ni: dzambha la yid bzhin nor bu'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'phags pa dzambha la bsgrub par 'dod pas: lug dkar po'i snying shun gyi nang du dar dmar po la 'khor lo 'di bris te rin po che sna lnga dang gong gi rdzas rnams kyis bkang la: de dar dmar po'i khog tu dril la maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhag: gtor ma'i yo byad dang chang phud bshams te: rang nyid dzambha la dmar po zhag gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas nor bu rin po che bsnams pa: g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa gcig tu skad cig gis bskyed la: de'i snying gar yi ge hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas gnod sbyin gyi gnas rnams dang : rin po che'i 'byung gnas rnams nas nor bu rin po che bkug nas bdag gi gnas rnams khengs par bsams la sngags 'dis zhag bdun bsgrub bo: oṃ dzambha la dha na a mu ka siddhi sa ma ya pha la sdus nor rdzas thams cad bdag la dung dung sdus swā hā:

de ltar bzlas pa byas pas rmi lam du nor rdzas ster ba dang : bsnyen bkur byed pa dang : rin po che'i gling du phyin pa dang : rin po che'i 'byung khungs nas nor rdzas mang po byung zhing rnyed pa'i rmi lam 'byung : dngos su yang zas nor ster ba 'byung ngo : ga'u rang gi dkor khang du sba'o: gtor ma ni dzambha la ba linta khā hi khā hi zhes pas dbul lo: longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro: dpal dzambha la'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so: ༈ dzambha la dmar po'i dbang bskur ba ni: gnas dben par maṇḍal mda' gang byas la padma 'dab brgyad bya: de'i nang du chang thod pa mtshan ldan gang la bu ram btab pa gcig gzhag: gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba la sha mar dang bu ram gyis brgyan: shar du bum pa: nub tu chu sbyin gyi snod zangs gzhong du sku gzhug: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byin la: thod pa lag tu bzhag ste: khams gsum snying khrag bsdus pa'i bcud: byang chub sems ni dmar la dwangs: khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i rdzas: bu yis blangs pas dngos grub thob: oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba sbyin la: yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba yis: khams gsum kun gyi nor bsdus pa: 'dod rgu char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal: bu la byin pas dngos grub thob: sngags 'dren no: de nas chu sbyin byas la chu sbyin: lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba'i rjes gnang byin la tshogs 'khor la rol: dzam la dmar po'i lung 'bogs pa la 'bul ba med par byar mi rung : che 'byor chung 'byor phul bas rin po che'i bye brag cung zad re dang zas sna khyad par can cung zad re 'bul ba phyag len no// bla ma mnyes: de nas lung sbyin: de ltar byas pas slob ma la byin rlabs 'jug go: : gdams pa 'di slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas su sbas pa grwa pa mngon shes kyis gter nas bton/

de nas rim par brgyud do// ༈ /gzhan thams cad gzhung bzhin la/ thod pa mtshan ldan dang gtor ma padma'i dbus su 'jog tshogs rdzas byang du 'jog rin po che'i bye brag re dang zas sna khyad par can cung zad re 'bul ba phyag len yin/ dbang gi dus lha bsgom pa dang zhes pa'i skabs su/ dpon slob gnyis ka sgrub pa gong ma ltar bskyed/ sngags kyi skabs rtsa sngags bla ma'i zhal nas dmar na ra ra byung ba slob ma'i khar zhugs te lus dmar mer gyis khengs par bsams la rtsa sngags brgya rtsa gcig gnyis kas brjod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs bya'o// ༈ /sgab 'dre mnan pa ni: dzambha la bsgrub pa la bar chad kyi gnod pa dang mi 'grub par byed pa la: gnod sbyin brel phongs zhes bya ba mi sdug pa zhig yod pa: de mnan pa'i thabs ni: mi nag bya'i mchu can zhig bris la tha ma sngags kyis bskor: sātstsha rab gnas byas pa'i zhabs su bcug la gad pa nag po'i zhabs su mnan par bya'o: des bar chad mi 'byung zhing 'grub thag nye'o: de 'dra'i mnan pa ma shes na: bar gcod gegs rnams byed par 'gyur: gnod sbyin brel phongs mnan cing gnod pa srung ba : dzam la sgrub pa mang yod kyang : log gnon mnan pa 'di med na: lag rdum brag la 'dzegs pa 'dra: de bas rin chen gser gyis bslu: kha po ngo dga' can la mi sbyin no: sa ma ya: ༈ 'di'i zhal gdams ni/ khyi nag po'i spu yis gzugs kyi smad bcing pa gal che/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis dgug gzhug drag po bya'o// gzugs snag rlan gyis nag por bsgyur dgos/ sātstsha'i zhabs brus la ro gdan gyi tshul du gan rkyal mgo g.yas bstan bcug la 'jim pas dgag rang gi sgrub khang mthong ba'i byang phyogs kyi gad pa nag po'i 'og tu sba dgos rgyu yin/ mi nag gi rkang zhabs nas sngags mgo phyir bstan la bskor/ oṃ a

dpe gcig la/ oṃ tri dun tri lakṣa/ tri mā ra ya khug nan/ dun dun/ bar du gcod byed a ra nan hrī ra dza st+wambha ya nan/ zhes snang*/ tri dun tri mā ra ya khug nan: dun dun bar chad gnod byed mā ra ya nan: st+waṃ bha ya nan: a ra nan: zhes sngags kyis liṅga'i mtha' bskor ba gang mang bri/ ༈ /yang sris rkun kha chings ni/ oṃ hūm̐ bhrūm̐ ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ zhes tshogs bdag gi sngags phreng gcig tu bris la sre mong gi khar gzhug oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya swā hā: zhes dzam la'i sngags rin po che sna lnga 'bru lnga dang bcas pa ltag khung du gzhug oṃ badzra tsitta rā ga ru ge sdud ti ma ti skyol: skyol nor skyol bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs re ba skongs: zhes zhang blon gyi sngags sre mong gi mgo la bri/ de tshon skud sna lngas bcing*/ gla lpags kyis gtums mchan khung g.yon du bcang*/ sre thod ma'i bca' thabs so// ༈ /dzambha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// bla ma dang dzambha la dmar po yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i rjes gnang bya tshul rje btsun thugs rje chen po spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i gsung bzhin brjed thor bri'o// de la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du/ padma dmar po 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng*/ g.yas g.yon du thod pa chang gis bkang ba la bu ram btab pa dang*/ gtor ma zlum po dbal cung zad gtod pa rtsi dmar pos byugs pa la/ padma nor bu 'dra ba'i zan ril gyis bskor ba/ de la mar gyi nor bu la sogs pa dang sha bu ram rnams kyis brgyan pa/ thod pa dang gtor ma gnyis mañdzi'i khar gzhag de'i nye logs su chu sbyin gyi chas bum pa chu gtsang gis gang ba dang*/ zangs gzhong gi nang du sku yod na gzhag med kyang 'gal ba med do// 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma zlum gtor gcig la sha mar bu ram sogs zas sna gang 'dzom gyis bskor ba yang bsham/

de dag gi mtha' skor la chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga sgor mchod dam/ mdun la sbreng tshar la dgod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog nas dang*/ las kyi rdo rje'i nye logs su maṇḍal nas dang bcas pa gzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bsdus pa spyi dang mthun par byas la/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun/ sems can thams cad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir/ bdag gis 'phags pa dzambha la'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ brtan g.yo thams cad stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las a las zla ba: ma las nyi ma: pam̐ las padma'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge dzam̐ dmar po: de las 'od zer 'phros: sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal: tshur 'dus dzam̐ la thim: de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dzambha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: sku shin tu dmar ba: chags pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams can: klu chen po brgyad dang rin po che du mas spras pa: zhal g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba: rtsa zhal dmar ba: phyag g.yas dang po na rin po che: gnyis pas lcags kyu: g.yon dang pos thod pa rin po ches gang ba: gnyis pas zhags pa: tha ma gnyis kyis gter gyi ne'u le re re btsir nas bsnams pas nor bu skyugs pa: zhabs bzhis gnod sbyin nor bu skyugs pa gnyis mnan pa: de'i thugs kar hrīḥdamar po las sbas pa'i yum lha mo ku ru kulle sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma: phyag dang po gnyis mda' gzhu: g.yas 'og mas lcags kyu: g.yon 'og ma na zhags pa bsnams pa: de las las kyi mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas lcags kyu dang : g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa dpag tu med pa spros te: 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gang 'dod pa'i dngos po mi la sogs pa'i 'gro ba/

gser dngul la sogs pa'i dkor nor rnams lcags kyus bzung*/ zhags pas mgul pa la sogs pa nas bcings nas bkug ste rang gi khyim thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ yang dzambha la'i zhal dang ne'u le gnyis/ gnod sbyin gnyis rnams las gser g.yu mu tig bye ru la sogs pa zas nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyugs nas rang gi gnas khang thams cad gang bar bsams la sngags 'di bzla'o// oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā: zhes pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ de nas gtor ma gnyis chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ dbus kyi dmar gtor de nyid/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las zla ba zhes pa nas/ gnas khang thams cad khengs par bsam pa'i bar gong ltar byas la/ bzlas pa ni/ brtan byed du bsams la cung zad bzla/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ arghaṃ la sogs sngags kyis dbul/ shabda la dril gsil bya/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung las rab sprul zhing : thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs: dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzambha la: ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal lo: zhes pas bstod la/ gtor chung zas snas brgyan pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rin po che las grub pa'i snod du gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces brjod cing byin rlabs byas te/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ dzambha la'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin dang*/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// de nas gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'ang pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir grwa pa mngon shes nas brgyud pa'i dzambha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub par bya ba la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ mdun gyi gtor ma 'di nyid dzambha la zhal gsum phyag drug par bskyed nas brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar dgos pa 'khor dang bcas pa da lan nas grub par bgyis te/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ bla ma dang dzambha la tha mi dad pa la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad par zhu/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dzambha la la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar/ khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la dzambha la dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib dang nad gdon thams cad sbyangs nas lus 'od dmar po'i gong bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

'od de yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams a las zla ba zhes pa nas/ zhags pas mgul pa la sogs pa nas bcings nas bkug ste khyed rang rnams kyi gnas khang la sogs pa'i 'dug gnas thams cad gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad dzambha la dmar po'i sku rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug dang ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas dzambha la dmar po'i sku kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil la/ ngag tu/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā: ā we sha ya aḥ.aḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang yang brjod/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang khyed rang gnyis ka dzam̐ dmar du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du dzam̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor nas yod par mos pa byas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i dzam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du bzhugs/ snying ga'i dzam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā: lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/

de nas slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rang rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ slob ma'i mgo bor me tog 'thor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dzambha la dmar po'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed dang khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum yod pa'i mos pa byas la/ mdun bskyed kyi dzambha la'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ khyed rang dzam dmar du gsal ba'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po la thim pas/ lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sku'i rjes gnang thob/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dbus kyi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba khyed rang rnams kyi lag tu gtad nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ thod pa lag tu bzhag cing*/ khams gsum snying khrag bsdus pa'i bcud: byang chub sems ni dmar la dwangs: khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i rdzas: bu yis blangs pas dngos grub thob: oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas dbus kyi gtor ma lhar bskyed pa khyed rang rnams kyi lag tu gtad cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba yis: khams gsum kun gyi nor bsdus pas: 'dod rgu char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal: bu la byin pas dngos grub thob: oṃ dzambha la sogs sngags gong bzhin brjod/ de nas chu sbyin bya dgos pas/ gong gi bum pa dang zangs gzhong slob dpon gyi lag tu bzung*/ sku yod na dang*/ med na zangs gzhong du/ skad cig gis dzambha la dmar po zhal gsum zhes pa nas/ zhabs bzhis gnod sbyin nor bu skyugs pa gnyis mnan pa zhes pa'i bar sngar sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ de'i thugs kar ram̐ dmar pos mtshan pa/ ram̐ zhes brjod pa de las me 'bar te/ zhal gyi nang na yar me lce lhab kyis byung bas shin tu skom pas gdungs pa la zhal du chu gtsang phul ba las skom pa'i sdug bsngal zhi ste mnyes par bsams la/ chu gtsang sku yod na dbu dang*/ med na 'bul bar mos la/ dzambha la sogs sngags bzla zhing*/ slob dpon gyis g.yas kyi chu gtsang g.yon gyi zangs gzhong du blug go /de ltar byas pas mnyes te/ zhal dang ne'u le gnyis dang gnod sbyin gnyis rnams kyi zhal nas rin po che sna tshogs dang nor gyi rigs skyugs/ slar yang ne'u le gnyis btsir bas nor bu skyugs/ zhabs kyis gnod sbyin cher mnan pas nor bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams skyugs pas dbul phongs thams cad bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni chu sbyin bya ba ste/ de dag gis rjes su gnang ba legs par song nas/ 'di'i sgrub thabs sogs kyi lung gnang tshar ba dang*/ de rnams kyis rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa legs par gsan pa yin pas/ de dag gi skabs su zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyis rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ maṇḍal tshar ba dang*/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs phul te/

cha shas kyis longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyis grwa pa mngon shes nas brgyud pa'i dzambha la dmar po'i rjes gnang phul ba yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gso byin rlabs bya/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ba sogs spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma la bskyed pa'i lha rang gi snying gar thim/ dge ba bsngo ba bkra shis sogs skabs su gang bab bya'o// de ltar bkod pa'i rjes su gnang tshul gyi lag len gyi rim pa 'di ni/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs sems dpa' chen po spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzhes pa'i dus 'di'i rjes gnang sogs dges bzhin du bka' drin legs par bskyangs te nos pa'i tshe/ sngon gyi yig cha rnams zhal gsal bar ma mchis pas/ chos med snyom las mkhan sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis bka'i dgongs pa bkrol nas bya yul dgon par bris pa'o// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ grwa pa mngon shes/ grwa pa thugs rje 'bum/ shu la tsand+ra/ so ston tshul rgyal ba/ mkhan po nyi ma/ slob dpon don bzang pa/ dbu ma pa grub brtson/ bka' bcu pa bkra shis bzang po/ bla ma blo gros bzang po/ rje btsun seng ge/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ sems dpa' chen po spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /dzam dmar grwa pa'i gter ma'i rgyun khyer dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so// gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ 'dir grwa pa mngon shes lugs kyi dzam dmar bsgom par 'dod pas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes sogs skyabs 'gro ci 'grub dang*/

sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir bdag gis dzambha la bsgrub par bgyi'o// zhes sems bskyed lan gsum brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las zla ba/ ma las nyi ma/ pam̐ las padma'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge dzam̐ dmar po las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus dzam̐ la phog de yongs su gyur pa las dzambha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku shin tu dmar ba/ chags pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon sngo ba/ rtsa zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas dang po na rin po che/ bar pa lcags kyu/ g.yon dang po thod pa rin po ches gang ba/ gnyis pa zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis na gter gyi ne'u le re re bsnams nas btsir bas nor bu skyugs pa/ zhabs bzhis gnod sbyin nor bu skyugs pa gnyis mnan pa/ de'i thugs kar yi ge hrīḥdamar po las lha mo ku ru kulle dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ g.yas 'og ma lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa'i thugs kar hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros pas lha mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa grangs med pa spros te/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas kyi rnam pa gang 'dod pa la lcags kyus bzung zhags pas bcings nas rang gi khyim du drangs/ khang par mi shong ba tsam spungs te byin/ dzambha la'i zhal dang*/ ne'u le'i zhal dang*/ gnod sbyin nor skyugs gnyis po'i zhal rnams nas gser g.yu mu tig bye ru la sogs pa zad mi shes pa brul nas bdag gi khang pa khengs par gyur/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā: zhes ci mang bzla'o// mthar mi dmigs par bsam/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// chu sbyin ni/ mdun du zangs gzhong gi nang du bris 'bur gyi rten yod na de nyid lhar bsam/

rten med na lha bskyed la/ de'i thugs kar ram̐ dmar po las me 'bar te/ zhal nas me lce lhab kyis byung bas dzambha la de skom pas gdungs par bsams la/ oṃ dzambha la sogs sngags gong ltar brgya'am nyer gcig tsam brjod cing chu gtsang phul bas skom pa zhi nas mnyes te/ zhal nas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa dang*/ ne'u le gnyis kyang phyag gis btsir bas nor bu skyugs/ zhabs 'og gi nor bdag gnyis la zhabs kyis cher mnan pas kyang nor bu skyugs shing*/ de lta bu'i nor bus khyim gang bar bsams la mthar/ dzambha la'i zhal dang nor bdag ne'u le gnyis la rang gi lag pas reg pas dngos grub bdud rtsi dmar po'i rnam pa de nyid lce la myong bar bsams te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes chu la reg cing btungs pa'i lhag kyang rang gis longs spyad par bya'o// gtor bsngo byed na/ zangs gzhong nang du gtor ma rin po che 'bar ba dmar po la sha chang*/ sbrang bur zas sna 'bru snas brgyan pa'am/ ma 'byor na rang gang za ba'i kha zas de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan par gyur/ mdun du dzambha la 'khor bcas byon par bsams la/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi/ bdun nam gsum brjod pas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes nas nor gyi dngos grub stsol zhing gnas gsum nas rin po che 'dzag par bsam/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung las rab sprul zhing : thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs: dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzambha la: ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong la phyag 'tshal: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhis nor skyugs mnan: 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin rin chen dang : khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu gnyis: g.yas gnyis dang po bar pas bsnams par mdzad:

rin chen thod pa zhags pa g.yon gnyis na: tha gnyis ne'u le btsir zhing rin chen 'bebs: rnam mang rin chen nor gyi char phab nas: ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong la phyag 'tshal: zhal g.yas dkar bas lha rigs dbang du sdud: g.yon zhal sngo bas klu rigs dbang du sdud: dbus zhal dmar bas mi rnams dbang du sdud: srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo: sku la rin chen du mas rnam par brgyan: klu chen brgyad dang lha yi na bzas brgyan: sgeg pa'i nyams ldan 'gro ba kun yid sdud: mgon po dzambha la la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag la longs spyod nor chen dngos grub stsol: zhes bstod/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// zhes sogs brjod/ med na badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya'o// 'di yang ngag dbang dpal bzang gi rgyun khyer du gter gzhung las dge slong pad phrin gyis btus so// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
